items.title: W.T. "Ed" Kirkeby Interview, 1961-06-28
items.q: Nick LaRocca, and the old, uh, uh, Dixieland Jazz Band, formed a big organization with the little organization within it.

ctx.x: Well, you were closely associated with Fats later. Is that where you,

Well, uh, I went, uh, following Victor, uh, I went with, uh, the, uh, National Broadcasting Company, Consolidated Radio Artists, which was the band booking division. And we handled, uh, uh, Whiteman, and, uh, uh, Koo Kat, and, uh, we had, uh, Guy Lombardo, and, and Benny Goodman. In fact, it was, uh, during my regime at, uh, Victor, uh, that Benny Goodman broke wide open. I gave him the tune that broke him wide open. That was the Stomping at the Savoy. And, uh, he was making this tour, and, uh, well, the orders…
Was it a previously organized group?
